verdict.rationale: Factory's agent-readiness docs directly document a `/readiness-fix` slash command that automatically fixes failing criteria. It runs in the Factory App (web or desktop) or the Droid CLI, alongside `/readiness-report` for evaluating the repository. The documentation is brief, so the depth of the fixes is unproven. Missing for 10: detail on which criteria can be auto-fixed and how fixes are reviewed or applied, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can automatically fix failing agent-readiness criteria in my repository

citations.quote: Automatically fix failing criteria with the /readiness-fix slash command in a Factory App web or desktop session, or in the Droid CLI
Run the /readiness-report slash command in a Factory App web or desktop session, or in the Droid CLI, to evaluate a repository's readiness level
